category_description: KiwiSaver, the government contribution and New Zealand Superannuation.
subcategory_description: How KiwiSaver contributions, the government contribution and early withdrawals work.
label: KiwiSaver default employee contribution rate
context: The rate deducted from pay if an employee does not choose another rate. Employees can choose 3.5%, 4%, 6%, 8% or 10% of pay.

label: Minimum compulsory employer contribution
context: The lowest rate an employer must contribute, as a share of the employee's gross salary or wages, unless the employee is on a temporary rate reduction.

label: Highest employee contribution rate
context: The highest rate an employee can choose through payroll. A member who wants to give more can pay a scheme provider directly.

label: Employer contribution during a temporary rate reduction
context: An employer must lower the employee's contribution rate to this level when a temporary rate reduction applies. The employer can choose to match it.

subject_intro: What an employee puts into KiwiSaver, the default rate, the minimum an employer must add, and how a contribution rate can be changed.
